name: proxy-beta
description: Explore a working SMART on FHIR authorization proxy without deploying one. Connects to the public Proxy Smart beta at beta.proxy-smart.com, a full stack with seeded demo patients, and bundles a tour skill. Demo data only: public, shared, and reset without notice. For your own deployment install the `proxy` plugin instead.

interface.displayName: Proxy Smart Beta — the public demo deployment
interface.shortDescription: A live SMART on FHIR proxy with seeded data, nothing to install.
interface.longDescription: beta.proxy-smart.com runs the whole Proxy Smart stack — the authorization proxy, Keycloak, and a HAPI FHIR server with seeded demo patients, practitioners, observations, and imaging studies. This plugin connects to its admin MCP endpoint so you can see how SMART apps, scopes, users, and FHIR servers are wired on a deployment that already works, and try changes against it. It is a public shared environment that is reset without notice, so it is for evaluation only — never put real patient data in it.
